extra.final_summary:
Average flipper length by species (61 rows used, 3 excluded): Adelie 190.18 mm, Chinstrap 199.64 mm, Gentoo 215.14 mm.

Problems found and fixes:
- flipper_length_mm had 3 impossible negative values (-215, -228, -198) in rows 46, 47 and 63, outside the rules' valid range of 170-235 mm. I proposed excluding those rows and it was approved, so they no longer affect the averages.
- species labels were checked: all 3 values (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) match the allowed labels, no misspellings or case/space variants.
- No duplicate rows, no missing flipper lengths, and no numbers stored as text in the metric column.

Caveats:
- The island column has case/space variants ("torgersen", "Dream ") and body_mass_g has 3 numbers written as text, but neither is used by this question, so I left them alone.
- sex has 2 missing values; the rules say missing means unknown, so I did not guess them.
- The three excluded rows are dropped rather than corrected, since the true flipper lengths are unknown; if they were meant to be positive (e.g. sign errors), the averages would shift slightly.
